verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev lets you run tasks automatically on cron schedules and trigger them from your own backend code when events occur. It also sends email, Slack or webhook alerts on task failures, and users describe it as an IFTTT/Zapier/n8n-style tool written in code. Event-to-action automation therefore requires writing the triggering logic yourself, not declaring rules. missing for 10: a declarative rule or event-subscription mechanism (e.g. native webhook or event triggers with conditions), documentation of event-driven triggering beyond explicit code calls and cron, independent corroboration of rule-based automation.
